fixture: prepare_progress_fixture.py and test_progress_fixture.py (a determinate progress with a message and Stop button, and an indeterminate one, in one component window)
checks: the progress window is pixel-identical to the plugin-free window, apart from the indeterminate bar's animation

its message is published as text
its Stop button is a pressable button
the indeterminate progress is published without a value
advancing the progress updates its value and message
the Stop press reaches the component, as Progress Stopped reports for this run
4D quits normally after the stopped progress
VoiceOver reads the indicator by its title and progress
